propositions.text: Applicant seeks judicial review of Officer's refusal of work permit application.
propositions.quote: Mr. Dharamjit Singh Grewal (the “Applicant”) seeks judicial review of a decision of an officer (the “Officer”), refusing his application for a work permit.

propositions.text: Officer refused application because Applicant did not establish he would leave Canada after stay, per subsection 200(1)(b).
propositions.quote: The Officer denied the application on the grounds that the Applicant had not established that he would leave Canada at the end of his stay, as required by subsection 200(1)(b) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations, SOR/2002/227.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant seeks judicial review of Officer's refusal of work permit because Applicant did not establish he would leave Canada after stay.

propositions.text: Applicant is Indian citizen who applied for work permit in Feb 2023 for General Farm Worker in BC.
propositions.quote: The Applicant is a citizen of India. In or around February 2023, he applied for a work permit from outside Canada, for employment as a General Farm Worker in British Columbia.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant is Indian citizen who applied for work permit in Feb 2023 for General Farm Worker in BC.

propositions.text: Officer found Applicant did not show sufficient establishment in India based on savings and assets.
propositions.quote: The Officer found that the Applicant had not shown sufficient establishment in India, based on his savings and assets.

paragraphs.summary: Officer found Applicant did not show sufficient establishment in India based on savings and assets.

propositions.text: Applicant alleges breaches of procedural fairness from inability to address Officer's concerns and apprehension of bias.
propositions.quote: The Applicant argues that he suffered breaches of procedural fairness, arising from his inability to address the Officer’s concerns with his application, and from a reasonable apprehension of bias on the part of the Officer.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant alleges breaches of procedural fairness from inability to address Officer's concerns and apprehension of bias.

propositions.text: Applicant submits decision was unreasonable because Officer failed to consider evidence of financial establishment in India.
propositions.quote: As well, the Applicant submits that the decision was unreasonable, because the Officer failed to consider his evidence relating to financial establishment in India.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant submits decision was unreasonable because Officer failed to consider evidence of financial establishment in India.

propositions.text: Respondent argues Officer met procedural fairness standard for work permit application.
propositions.quote: The Minister of Citizenship and Immigration (the “Respondent”) argues that the Officer met the standard of procedural fairness required on a work permit application.

paragraphs.summary: Respondent argues Officer met procedural fairness standard for work permit application.

propositions.text: Respondent argues Officer reasonably reviewed evidence and reasonably denied application.
propositions.quote: Further, the Respondent argues that the Officer reasonably reviewed the evidence submitted by the Applicant and reasonably denied his application.

paragraphs.summary: Respondent argues Officer reasonably reviewed evidence and reasonably denied application.

propositions.text: Procedural fairness issues in judicial review are reviewed on correctness standard per Khosa.
propositions.quote: Any issue of procedural fairness arising in this application for judicial review is reviewable on the standard of correctness, following the decision in Canada (Citizenship and Immigration) v Khosa, [2009] 1 S.C.R. 339.

paragraphs.summary: Procedural fairness issues in judicial review are reviewed on correctness standard per Khosa.

propositions.text: Officer's decision is reviewable on reasonableness standard per Vavilov.
propositions.quote: Following the decision in Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration) v. Vavilov, [2019] 4 S.C.R. 653, the decision of the Officer is reviewable on the standard of reasonableness.

paragraphs.summary: Officer's decision is reviewable on reasonableness standard per Vavilov.

propositions.text: Reasonableness requires justification, transparency, intelligibility, and relation to factual and legal constraints per Vavilov.
propositions.quote: In considering reasonableness, the Court is to ask if the decision under review "bears the hallmarks of reasonableness — justification, transparency and intelligibility — and whether it is justified in relation to the relevant factual and legal constraints that bear on the decision"; see Vavilov, supra at paragraph 99.

paragraphs.summary: Reasonableness requires justification, transparency, intelligibility, and relation to factual and legal constraints per Vavilov.

propositions.text: Applicant failed to show any breach of procedural fairness by Officer.
propositions.quote: Upon considering the evidence and the submissions of the parties, in my view the Applicant has failed to show any breach of procedural fairness on the part of the Officer.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant failed to show any breach of procedural fairness by Officer.

propositions.text: Procedural fairness for work permit applications is at the lower end of the scale per Anenih.
propositions.quote: Procedural fairness due upon an application for a work permit is at the lower end of the scale; see the decision in Anenih v. Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2018 FC 718.

paragraphs.summary: Procedural fairness for work permit applications is at the lower end of the scale per Anenih.

propositions.text: Test for bias allegation is high per Committee for Justice & Liberty.
propositions.quote: The test for an allegation of bias is high; see the decision in Committee for Justice & Liberty v. Canada (National Energy Board), [1978] 1 S.C.R. 369.

paragraphs.summary: Test for bias allegation is high per Committee for Justice & Liberty.

propositions.text: Applicant did not identify specific evidence supporting bias allegation and failed to establish bias.
propositions.quote: The Applicant did not identify specific evidence in support of this allegation. He has not established bias on the part of the Officer.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant did not identify specific evidence supporting bias allegation and failed to establish bias.

propositions.text: Applicant did not show breach of procedural fairness; responsibility for sufficiency of materials was his.
propositions.quote: I am not persuaded that the Applicant has otherwise shown a breach of procedural fairness. He bore the responsibility for the sufficiency of the materials submitted in support of his application and the Officer was not obliged to bring concerns to his attention.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant did not show breach of procedural fairness; responsibility for sufficiency of materials was his.

propositions.text: Court not persuaded decision was unreasonable after reviewing materials and submissions.
propositions.quote: Upon reviewing the material and considering the submissions of the parties, I am not persuaded that the decision is unreasonable.

paragraphs.summary: Court not persuaded decision was unreasonable after reviewing materials and submissions.

propositions.text: Officer reasonably commented on relevant matters including lack of bank statements; conclusion reasonable relative to materials.
propositions.quote: In my opinion, the Officer commented on relevant matters arising from the Applicant’s application, including the lack of bank statements required by the application process. The Officer’s conclusion is reasonable relative to the materials submitted.

paragraphs.summary: Officer reasonably commented on relevant matters including lack of bank statements; conclusion reasonable relative to materials.

propositions.text: No basis for judicial intervention; application for judicial review dismissed; no question for certification.
propositions.quote: There is no basis for judicial intervention and this application for judicial review will be dismissed. There is no question for certification.

paragraphs.summary: No basis for judicial intervention; application for judicial review dismissed; no question for certification.
